facts.text: The attached assessment sheet lists a one-storey gross floor area of 92,376 sq ft (8,582 m²).
The letter lists ESFR sprinkler flow of 5,610 L/min, a 1,892 L/min hose allowance, a 90-minute duration, and 675,000 L stored fire-water volume as its engineered proposal.

The assessment sheet identifies FUS 2020, Ottawa Design Guidelines for Water Distribution (2010), ISTB-2018-02 and Technical Bulletin ISTB-2021-03; its final sheet reports 7,500 L/min total required fire flow after a 25% Step I reduction for ESFR sprinklers.
